evidence.detail: rotation_redis_store() builds cs from Counter(lines).most_common() — only cards that appeared in at least one rotation file are processed; zero-hit cards are never added to cs
newly_eliminated = [c for c in cs if ...] — cs never contains zero-hit cards, so they can never appear in newly_eliminated
Comment on issue confirms: 'Rotation doesn't know any cards exist that don't have at least one hit'

triage.notes: Fix requires querying oracle for all playable cards and computing the zero-hit set at the run where they first become eliminated (runs == threshold + 1 = 85 for TOTAL_RUNS=168). Product judgment needed on whether to list zero-hit eliminated cards by name or just by count, and whether the oracle.cards_by_name() call in rotation_hype_message() is acceptable performance-wise.
